feat(territory): preserve hive slot identity and scoring evidence

Preserve deterministic hive proposal keys, groups and open Governor slot metadata through preview acceptance. Keep canonical and plan-local external Governor identity transitions consistent with slot state. Add executable evidence for exact 40/25/20/15 officer scoring, unavailable missing components, pinned inputs and deterministic results.

Evidence: 20 frontend tests; 4 hive/suggestion PHP tests with 56 assertions; vue-tsc and scoped ESLint pass. PR remains draft.
